The EIA raising its WTI forecast by $2.64 confirms official US government recognition of structurally higher oil prices driven by the blockade and broader Middle East risk. Record supertanker orders indicate the shipping market is pricing in a permanently elevated risk premium for Hormuz transit. This is structurally bullish for oil prices (WTI $85-90 range) and tanker rates. The blockade is the Trump administration's primary leverage in Iran negotiations — its demonstrated effectiveness strengthens the 'no deal without blockade relief' position.
